notes.content:
[p][b]Captains,[/b]
The following changes were applied on the Test Server today, September 23:[/p][list][*][p]Chain shot damage to crew and hull reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Mortar damage to crew reduced (to match Live Server values)[/p][/*][*][p]Round shot, double shot, and double charge damage to sails and masts slightly increased[/p][/*][*][p]NPC chain shot behavior adjusted: new minimum/maximum distance thresholds and firing angle[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Redeemables Update on Test Server: L’Ocean & Supplies
notes.content: [p][b]Captains,[/b][/p][p]As requested by players, the following items have been added to the [b]redeemables[/b] on the [b]Test Server[/b] to allow everyone to experience large fleet battles:[/p][list][*][p]L’Ocean with Teak / Teak frame and planking and five slots for modules[/p][/*][*][p]500,000 gunpowder[/p][/*][*][p]50,000 cannonballs[/p][/*][*][p]1,000 hull repairs[/p][/*][*][p]1,000 rig repairs[/p][/*][*][p]32 × 42-pdr long guns[/p][/*][*][p]34 × 24-pdr long guns[/p][/*][*][p]38 × 12-pdr long guns[/p][/*][*][p]22 × 9-pdr long guns[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]How to Claim[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Ensure you have at least one spare dock slot.[/p][/*][*][p]While in port, press [b]R[/b] (or click the [i]Redeemables[/i] button at the top-right of the port UI).[/p][/*][*][p]Open the [i]Redeemables[/i] tab [b]Gifts & Rewards[/b] and redeem the items.[/p][/*][*][p]Once redeemed:[/p][list][*][p]The ship will be placed in your port dock.[/p][/*][*][p]Ammunition and guns will be placed in your [b]Reward Chest[/b], from which you can transfer them to the port warehouse or directly to your ship hold.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]We wish you [b]fun and epic battles![/b][/p]

notes.title: Test Server Update, September 18

notes.title: Test Server Update – September 15: Raking Fire and Leaks Change
notes.content: [h3]Raking Fire Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Greatly increased grape and splinter damage from cannons.[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly increased the number of cannons destroyed during raking fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Grape shot damage is now effective up to 500 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased bow hitpoints to allow closing distance with more safety [/p][/*][/list][p]Previously, raking fire was not a particularly effective tactic. We want to make it viable again. We look forward to your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Slightly increased the impact of angling — previously cannons could penetrate armor up to 45 degrees, now they can do so at roughly 40–43 degrees.[/p][/*][*][p]Successfully inflicted leaks from a single broadside can sink a ship if the captain does not react in time and shift the entire crew to Survival Focus.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced the hitpoints of mast sections.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Test Server Update: Penetration Rework on Fresh Database from Caribbean Server
notes.content:
[p][b]IMPORTANT: DATABASE RESET FOR TESTBED (TESTBED FULLY WIPED)[/b]
The current database on the testbed is from the Caribbean Main Server of September 12 maintenance time.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Changes to Cannon Penetration and Hull Thickness[/b][/p][p]Improved base angling, which can be further enhanced by stacking thickness.
This is the first step; additional improvements will be introduced next week.[/p][list][*][p]The penetration values of all cannons have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]The hull thickness of all ships has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Cannons can penetrate the hull at angles up to 45–50 degrees relative to the target.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New penetration pattern:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Medium Guns – penetrate the hull at distances up to 1500 m.[/p][/*][*][p]Long Guns – penetrate the hull at distances up to 2000 m.[/p][/*][*][p]Carronades – penetrate the hull at distances up to 1000 m.[/p][/*][/list][p]When firing at a ship with maximum hull thickness bonuses, these distances are reduced by approximately 500 m.[/p][p]The main goal of these changes is to increase the impact of angling and thickness on combat outcomes.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Bind on Pickup (BoP) Mechanic[/b][/p][list][*][p]With this update, modules and books become bound to the player who first obtained them.[/p][/*][*][p]These items cannot be sold or transferred to other players, and they cannot be placed on contracts.[/p][/*][*][p]These items cannot be moved into ships that do not belong to their owner (including derelict ships).[/p][/*][*][p][b]If a player leaves BoP items inside a ship and then makes that ship a derelict, the BoP items will disappear when another player opens the hold of that derelict.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Privateer perk – the extra module drop (SEARCH) has been removed.[/p][/*][/list][p]This change will allow us to significantly increase the drop chances of these items in one of the upcoming hotfixes – for example, making it easier to collect a full set of desired books and modules.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Clan Leaderboard and Conquest Missions[/b][/p][list][*][p]The clan leaderboard has been updated with improved visualization of sorting. Only the top 10 clans are displayed for each sorting criterion.[/p][/*][*][p]To take a conquest mission, a player must belong to a clan that is in the Top 10.[/p][/*][*][p]A ship battle rating requirement has been added to conquest missions, similar to port battles.[/p][/*][*][p]When taking a conquest mission, the ship used by the player is recorded. Losing that ship will cause the mission to fail.[/p][/*][*][p]A conquest mission can only be successfully completed (leading to port battle scheduling) if the player finishes the final battle in the same ship that the player used to accept the mission.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that this is not the final version of the conquest mission system. Final adjustments and balance changes will be released in one of the upcoming patches. We are looking forward to your feedback on these changes.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Other Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The real payout per unit of damage has been increased from 2 to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum efficiency of trading has been limited to approximately one hour per trade route.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting recipes have been slightly adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]The final balance of income will be released in one of the upcoming updates.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Update on the Investigation of the Exploit with Items[/b]
During the last week we removed over 50 rare books, modules, and guns that remained on other players after exploiters were banned.[/p][p]Several improvements have also been made to the exploit system, which should prevent possible duplication issues in the future:[/p][list][*][p]During trade, items placed in the offer are locked and cannot be moved, split, equipped, or otherwise modified until the trade is completed. Direct trade remains fully available. The only items that cannot be traded under any circumstances are bind-on-pickup ones.[/p][/*][*][p]It is no longer possible to transfer a ship that has items in its hold.[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to install modules and cannons via drag and drop has been removed. To equip them on a ship, you now need to click on the appropriate ship slots and select from the list of available items.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Spotlight image from Captain Malik from the February 2022 screenshot competition.[/p]

notes.title: Test Server Update – August 26: Sailing & RvR Changes
notes.content:
[p]Captains,[/p][p]
The following changes were applied today on the Testbed Server:[/p][p] [/p][h3]Updated Conquest Mission Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]The Conquest Flag item has been removed from RvR - you can still exchange it for doubloons.[/p][/*][*][p]The right to undertake conquest missions is now granted to the top 10 clans on the national leaderboard, determined by specific Activity Points accumulated during the past 7 days.[/p][/*][*][p]The price of Conquest Missions is tied to the level of activity within the targeted port.[/p][/*][/list][p]Once you take a conquest mission, the rest of the flow remains the same — you must start the mission within 45 minutes and then survive inside it for another 45 minutes, after which the Port Battle is scheduled for the next day.

These changes aim to eliminate several issues with the previous Conquest Flag mechanic that were reported by players.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Updated Sailing Model[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted rudder turn values based on the kinematic characteristics of ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated rudder curve.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated acceleration and deceleration for all ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated ship inertia.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked speed loss mechanics from rudder inertia for all ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased ship turning from sails at low speeds.[/p][/*][/list][p]The purpose of this update is to establish a consistent tacking pattern. For example:[/p][list][*][p]If a ship begins a tack with sufficient speed, it should retain positive speed by the end of the maneuver.[/p][/*][*][p]If a ship starts a tack from low speed, it will stall and end up moving backwards.[/p][/*][/list][p]In the current Testbed implementation, speed loss due to rudder inertia only affected ships under Battle Sails, leaving full sails unaffected. With this update:[/p][list][*][p]Rudder inertia will reduce speed by up to 50% of a ship’s maximum speed, regardless of sail plan.[/p][/*][*][p]After that threshold, the impact of rudder inertia becomes negligible.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Other Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Sail damage caused by chain shot reduced by about 38%, based on player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gun damage increased by about 5% across all guns.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]*Spotlight image by Captain Lord Dorian Beckett from the June 2021 screenshot competition.[/p]

notes.title: Test Server is Live - August 2025 Major Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]Captains,
[/b][/p][p]The Test Server is now available.[/p][p]These are preliminary patch notes for the start of the Test Server. Full patch notes will be announced later during the Testbed phase.
[/p][p][b]Goals for the Test Server [/b][/p][p]To test the new features of the game, including:[/p][p][b]Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players will now earn reals based on the damage they inflict in battles (applies to both PvP and PvE). Initially, players will receive 2 reals for each point of damage dealt. The conversion rate may be adjusted based on feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Experience is awarded only for confirmed kills (applies to both PvP and PvE).[/p][/*][*][p]The Daily Leaderboard will reward the top 15 players on both the Caribbean and Peace servers. The leaderboard is based on received battle experience. Prize Chests will be placed in the Reward Chest.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sailing Model[/b][/p][list][*][p]In the past, the sailing and maneuvering characteristics of ships were balanced primarily based on damage per minute, which meant that mid-tier vessels could not overtake an opponent if the enemy held the most favorable point of sail. Now, all ships are divided into four distinct classes: [/p][list][*][p][b]Line Ships[/b] (1st–3rd Rates)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavy Ships[/b] (some 3rd Rates and 4th Rates)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interceptors[/b] (5th Rates)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Light Interceptors[/b] (6th–7th Rates).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Each ship within these classes has its own optimal point of sail, allowing Interceptors and Light Interceptors to overtake heavier ships even when those are sailing on their most advantageous course.[/p][/*][*][p]Below is a summary chart of the new classification:
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfLhKDFm0UITYcIVvh1WLQWhxsy9CxTSGuFZ8rdulIjkEF7qizmf6bQGUe27AOan8MmKHy7qo9Wrlvc4sy5tz0XTxV4ZFXGnQDWYeqcvnQsQjRJsP9hseYFWexsumhWE-qJ2MHnVg?key=xzVRUmg7z00AoJ9ncTFIiA"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]In line with this classification, the speed, turning rate, acceleration, and deceleration of ships have been updated for each class.[/p][/*][*][p]The mechanics of speed loss due to rudder inertia have been made more pronounced to prevent situations where captains could repeatedly switch broadsides by performing 180-degree turns with little to no loss of speed. The current system is configured as follows:[/p][list][*][p]First Rates lose speed to a certain threshold after a single 180‑degree turn while under Battle Sails.[/p][/*][*][p]Seventh Rates lose speed to a certain threshold after seven 180‑degree turns while under Battle Sails.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We have reinstated the mechanic where sail efficiency decreases with each additional sail set. Ships receive the maximum efficiency bonus under a Half Sails Plan, with efficiency gradually declining as more canvas is spread. At Full Sails, no efficiency bonus is applied. This mechanic will make combat under Battle Sails more comfortable, as new systems (such as improved leak mechanics) encourage the use of Battle Sails to reduce excessive heel.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Damage Model[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved leak mechanics.[b] [/b]Previously, some ships were more prone to leaking than others. Now, ships with significant heel will receive leaks more consistently, while ships with little or no heel cannot be leaked.[/p][/*][*][p]Demasting with confidence — chain shot size and mast colliders have been updated to make mast hits more reliable compared to previous demasting.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated ammunition parameters. Previously, double charge had an unfair advantage, being not only the best ammunition for long‑range penetration but also the most effective at retaining full damage over very long distances compared to round shot. With this update, all types of shot except grape shot now retain full damage up to a maximum of 750 meters. Beyond that distance, both round shot and double charge gradually lose damage up to 3,000 meters in the same way. Double shot and chain shot deal negligible damage beyond 750 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced fire chance for all ships based on player feedback. For example, if on average your ship caught fire once every 2 battles, it will now catch fire once every 3 battles.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]AI Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved NPC behavior in battle. NPCs now properly evaluate their position relative to the wind when choosing a side to engage and make more reasonable decisions about switching broadsides, taking reload times into account. These changes allow NPCs to avoid unnecessary maneuvers. 
This is the first stage of AI improvements. In the future, NPCs will also learn to properly evaluate the condition of their broadsides and better control their speed relative to the enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Alive NPC ships will now leave the instance immediately once the “Battle Over” message appears.[/p][/*][*][p]Capture zones have been removed from Port Battles against neutral NPCs — players must now earn points by sinking NPC ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where NPC ships in conquest missions did not provide loot — they now do.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Port Management[/b][/p][list][*][p]Port owners can now set up contract rights in the port. There are 4 modes:[/p][list][*][p]Clan[/p][/*][*][p]Clan and Friends[/p][/*][*][p]National[/p][/*][*][p]Everyone[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Port owners can now change the visual style of their port and build or maintain fortifications.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] The cost for visual style changes and building fortifications is temporarily set to 100 doubloons so that all players can experience the new features. The final cost will be set upon patch release on live servers.[/p][/*][*][p]Each fortification requires a supply of gunpowder and ball ammunition to operate. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Modules and Books[/b][/p][list][*][p]Open World warships and Raider warships loot:[/p][list][*][p]Added approximately 180 new modules, primarily of purple and gold quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 15 new books with an increased drop chance. These books cannot be combined into combo books.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]How to access the test server[/b][/p][p]Instructions on how to unlock the test server and participate are posted on the official forum:[/p][p][url="https://forum.bermudaclub.net/topic/44292-naval-action-beta-test-server-%E2%80%93-how-to-participate/"]How to Participate[/url] [/p][p] [/p][p]REWARDS for participating on the Test Server will be announced later during the Testbed phase.[/p][p][/p][p]Most useful and thoughtful feedback providers will also receive a special reward once the live server patch goes live.[/p][p][/p][p]Players start on the Test Server with the Caribbean Main Server database from the morning of August 5, 2025.
[/p][p]Important Note: The information in these patch notes will be updated and expanded throughout the Testbed phase.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions about the reasoning behind these changes, please share them in the feedback topics so we can take them into consideration for future patch notes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Feedback[/b][/p][p]Feedback can be provided here on Steam: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/311310/discussions/22/601911983259832586/"]Steam Forums[/url][/p][p]And here on the official forum: [url="https://forum.bermudaclub.net/topic/44410-naval-action-test-server-august-2025-feedback-thread/"]Official Forum[/url][/p][p]Also let us know if you have any questions in the comments.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Raider Port Battles on Peace server – What to Expect
notes.content:
[b]Captains,[/b]

Here is a summary of what to expect in Raider Port Battles:

There are [b]six types[/b] of Raider Port Battles.
The number of allowed players is [b]25[/b], or up to the [b]BR limit[/b], whichever comes first.

[h2]Shallow-Water Battles[/h2]

[b]Total BR: 325[/b]
• NPC ships: 9 warships and 4 traders
• Largest NPC warship: [i]Rattlesnake[/i]
• Allowed player ships: From [i]Lynx[/i] (Min BR 13) to [i]Le Gros Ventre Refit[/i] (Max BR 40)

[b]Total BR: 1000[/b]
• NPC ships: 21 warships and 4 traders
• Largest NPC warship: [i]La Renommée[/i]
• Allowed player ships: From [i]Lynx[/i] (Min BR 13) to [i]Le Gros Ventre Refit[/i] (Max BR 40)

[h2]Deep-Water Battles[/h2]

[b]Total BR: 1450[/b]
• NPC ships: 13 warships and 4 traders
• Largest NPC warship: [i]Trincomalee[/i]
• Allowed player ships: From [i]Mortar Brig[/i] (Min BR 15) to [i]Wapen von Hamburg[/i] (Max BR 120)

[b]Total BR: 2975[/b]
• NPC ships: 20 warships and 4 traders
• Largest NPC warship: [i]Wapen von Hamburg[/i]
• Allowed player ships: From [i]Mortar Brig[/i] (Min BR 15) to [i]Wapen von Hamburg[/i] (Max BR 120)

[b]Total BR: 3300[/b]
• NPC ships: 19 warships and 6 traders
• Largest NPC warship: [i]Bellona[/i]
• Allowed player ships: From [i]Mortar Brig[/i] (Min BR 15) to [i]Duke of Kent[/i] (Max BR 353)

[b]Total BR: 6000[/b]
• NPC ships: 19 warships and 6 traders
• Largest NPC warship: [i]Santísima Trinidad[/i]
• Allowed player ships: From [i]Mortar Brig[/i] (Min BR 15) to [i]Duke of Kent[/i] (Max BR 353)

[h2]Additional Rules[/h2]

• Port Battle ship limits are based on [b]Battle Rating (BR)[/b], not ship rank.
• For example, in Port Battles with a BR limit of 1450 or 2975, you can bring [b]any ship with a BR lower than [i]Wapen von Hamburg[/i][/b] (even if it’s a 3rd rate ship), and [b]higher than [i]Mortar Brig[/i][/b].

• Players can join a Raider Port Battle [b]up to 10 minutes after it has started[/b].

• Please review the detailed guide on Port Battle Timers and Raiders available on the official forum:
https://forum.bermudaclub.net/topic/44321-port-battle-timers-and-raiders-overhauled-systems-explained/

notes.title: IMPORTANT: Raider Attacks on Peace Server Begin Friday, May 16
notes.content:
Captains,

Starting Friday, May 16, Raiders will begin attacking ports on the Peace Server.

Please review the detailed guide on Port Battle Timers and Raiders available on the official forum:
https://forum.bermudaclub.net/topic/44321-port-battle-timers-and-raiders-overhauled-systems-explained/

[h3]Reminder on Port Battle Ship Limits[/h3]

You can easily judge which ship you can take into a battle by looking at Port BR:

[list]
[*] [b]325 BR[/b] - from Lynx [[b]Min BR 13[/b]] to Le Gros Ventre Refit [[b]Max BR 40[/b]]

notes.title: MATERIA PRIMA Patch and Final Last Wipe and Reset
notes.content:
[b]Captains[/b],

A major Naval Action update has been deployed today, April 10.

[b]IMPORTANT[/b] - don’t delete your player once you create the account (for any reason) You will lose the granted XP. Use forged papers.

[h3]Wipe and Experience Merge Information[/h3]

All assets and items have been reset and deleted on the Caribbean and Peace servers.

Battle Experience above the Master and Commander rank (rank 5) will be preserved per Steam ID and automatically granted when creating a new character — for all characters who had previously reached Master and Commander or higher. Previously, the M&C rank was granted to all those who finished the Final Exam.

Equivalent Ranks for M&C Across Nations:
[list]
[*] Great Britain: Master and Commander
[*] Spain: Capitán de Fragata
[*] France: Capitaine de Frégate
[*] Pirates: Rover
[/list]
[h3]Key Features of the Update[/h3]

[b]Damage Model[/b]: Overhauled ammunition, HP, leaks, fires, thickness, boarding, and various other adjustments.

[b]Sailing Model[/b]: Streamlined speed profiles for all ships, rudder inertia, and other tuning improvements.

[b]Crafting[/b]: Full overhaul to the crafting progression.

[b]Trading[/b]: Trade resources are back in production with trade routes and distance-based pricing.

[b]Player-Driven Economy and Hauling[/b]: Crafted goods required for combat and trading provide even better money-making opportunities than trading. All higher-level content has to be crafted by players.

[b]New Modules and Books[/b]: Complete overhaul of modules and books.

[b]Dozens[/b] of other changes and improvements, giving an almost completely new experience.

[h3]Battle Experience Merge (From War Server to Caribbean Server)[/h3]

If you had a character on the War server and its Battle Experience was higher than on the Caribbean server, your Battle Experience from the War server will replace the Battle Experience on the Caribbean server.

[b]Examples[/b]:

Your current rank on the Caribbean server is Second Lieutenant.
Your previous rank on the closed War server was Commodore.
Outcome: Upon creating a new character on the Caribbean server, you will be granted the Battle Experience required for Commodore rank.

Your current rank on the Caribbean server is Rear Admiral.
Your previous rank on the closed War server was Second Lieutenant.
Outcome: Upon creating a new character on the Caribbean server, you will be granted the Battle Experience required for Rear Admiral.

[h3]Information on Clans on the Caribbean Server and Their Clan Tags[/h3]

Clans will be automatically created for the clan owners if two conditions are met:
[olist]
[*] Clan Owner Rank: From Master and Commander and above
[*] Clan Members Count: Minimum 3 members
[/olist]
The clan will be created upon character creation. [b]This opportunity will last for two weeks[/b]. If you do not create a clan within this two-week period, the clan tag will be set free for use by others.

If you want to change the clan tag, you will need to delete your current clan and create a new one.

[h2]IMPORTANT – USING YOUR OLD CLAN TAG[/h2]

If you were the owner of a clan on the Caribbean server with at least 3 members, your clan will be created automatically.

Clan is linked to your Steam ID – not your name.
Clan is linked to your Steam ID – not your nation.

You can make a new account, use a new name, and choose a different nation.
Your clan will still be created, and you will be the owner.

Reminder:
Clan ownership is based on Steam ID

notes.title: Test Server Battle Rating Loot Overhaul – March 28

[h3]Battle Rating-Based Loot from NPCs in the Open World[/h3]

NPC ship loot in the Open World is now based on Battle Rating (BR) instead of ship rank.
This update allows for more accurate loot distribution between ships with the same rank but significantly different BRs (e.g., Brig vs. Le Gros Ventre Refit, Surprise vs. Trincomalee, or Wasa vs. Implacable).

Previously, rank-based loot meant that Surprise and Trincomalee would carry identical loot.

With the new BR-based system, Surprise and Trincomalee will now carry loot more in line with ships of similar BR.

[b]PVE looting is now the most profitable activity in the game on a per-hour basis.[/b]

Captains, the following changes were deployed on the Test Server today, March 15th:

[list]
[*] Wind shadow additional issues found and fixed
[*] Ship mast height will now properly affect the shadow size 
[*] Overall effect of wind shadow is slightly decreased
[*] The strongest distance wind shadow is at 1 hull length
[*] Smaller vessels will no longer be able to steal 50% of your wind if you are in a much bigger ship. Small ships will have very low "dirty air" effect 
[/list]

notes.title: Test Server Hotfix - March 14th
notes.content:
Captains, the following changes were deployed on the Test Server today, March 14th:

[list]
[*] Slightly increased gunpowder and ammunition loot for warship NPCs in Open World
[*] Maximum gunpowder amount in contracts increased to 50,000
[*] Maximum ball, chain, and grape ammunition in contracts increased to 20,000
[*] Fixed a bug where certain ships were not allowed to participate in Port Battles
[*] Applied an additional fix for the Santa Cecilia Blueprint availability
[*] Fixed a bug related to incorrect raider Port Battle date allocation
[/list]

notes.title: Test Server Update - March 13th
notes.content:
Captains, following changes were deployed today, March 13th, on the Test Server:

[h3]Game Mechanics & Economy Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crafting recipes have been overhauled, reducing the number of trips required to craft consumables, ships, and guns.
[*] Updated prices for consumables available in port shops and some raw resources.
[*] Gunpowder maximum stack increased from 25,000 to 50,000.
[*] Ball Ammo, Chain Ammo, and Grape Ammo maximum stacks increased from 10,000 to 20,000.
[*] Wind Shadow and Rigging Shock now correctly affect ship speed and inertia.
[*] Rudder penalty now correctly affects ship speed and inertia.
[*] Updated bonuses for certain perks and wood types.
[*] Slightly increased marines' effectiveness in boarding actions.
[*] 5th and 4th rate NPC ships now use gray quality modules in boarding.
[*] 3rd, 2nd and 1st rate NPC ships now use green quality modules in boarding.
[*] Port Battles are now scheduled 24 hours after the Conquest Flag is deployed.
[*] Slightly increased loot from trader ships.
[*] The patrol around Puerto Plata has been moved closer to La Tortue.
[/list]
[h3]General Changes & Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now trade at ports without owning an outpost.
[*] The fishing bind option has been disabled in Game Settings until further notice.
[*] Exam requirements: Players must reach 2nd battle rank to start exams and 3rd battle rank for the Final Exam.
[*] Final Exam rewards are now placed in the Reward Chest.
[*] Items purchased from the Admiralty are now placed in the ship’s hold if the player does not own an outpost.
[*] Fixed a missing Santa Cecilia Blueprint bug.
[*] Fixed port tax bugs when purchasing ships from captured ports.
[*] Fixed a crash bug when crafting 42-pound long guns.
[/list]


[i]Spotlight image by [IX] Archi from the March 2022 screenshot competition[/i]

notes.title: Test Server Hotfix - March 7th and March 8th
notes.content:

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to contracts
[*] Fixed a bug causing crew members to disappear

notes.title: Test Server Hotfix - March 6th
notes.content:
Captains, following items are issued in the Redeemable for all players:

[list]
[*] [b]Gunpowder: 70,000[/b] (found in the Gifts & Rewards tab)
[*] [b]Ball Ammo: 5,000[/b] (found in the Gifts & Rewards tab)
[*] [b]Doubloons: 30,000[/b] (found in the Gifts & Rewards tab)
[*] [b]Experience[/b]: Amount required to reach the [b]Commodore rank[/b] (found in the Reals & XP Grant tab)
[/list]
[b]Items are placed in the Reward Chest upon claim[/b]
[h3]Other changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The minimal possible damage during boarding actions has been increased
[*] Medicinal bark now spawns across various regions
[*] Rewards for patrol missions have been increased
[*] Armor HP Bonuses related to wood, modules, and books have been adjusted
[*] Guns now consume less gunpowder; for example, a 42-pounder gun now requires only 8 units of gunpowder
[*] Recipes for gunpowder and medicine have been reworked to improve logistics, addressing previous issues where required materials and raw resources occupied significant hold space
[/list]
[h1]Important Information on Contracts[/h1]
We are aware of the bugs affecting contracts, and fixing them is currently our top priority, along with issues related to crew disappearing when switching from a ship with a larger crew to a smaller one.

Until the contract bugs are resolved, please avoid setting up new contracts or claiming existing ones.

notes.title: Test Server Hotfix - March 3rd
notes.content:
Captains, the following changes were deployed on the Test Server today, March 3rd:

[h3]Boarding improvement[/h3]
[list]
[*] Boarding has been tweaked closer to old school boarding (but with less Cooldowns) including return of the command switch cost
[*] Free preparation per round bonus has been removed 
[*] KD on brace, attack has been removed allowing more action
[*] Defend command is made not so useless against gun or cannon fire
[*] Min possible damage was increased to not get stuck in 3 kills per round 
[*] Overall, we definitely will need another round of changes to bring it to great state - please provide feedback and thought on boarding in patch feedback topics
[/list]
[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug blocking ship purchases
[*] Reduced minimum fees for distant ship purchases to 500 from 5000
[*]NPC tax is back to avoid price gauging and free 1 real overbidding on auctions 
[*]Double shot bonus is now lower until ball cost balance is achieved. Reason is simple - because there is one standard cannonball the cost of double shot was extremely low compared to its received benefit. It will be increased once gunpowder and cannonball prices are finally balanced
[*] Fixed Crafting Recipes for the following items:

[list]
[*]Medicine
[*]Grape Ammo
[*]Provisions
[*]Gunpowder
[*]Ball Ammo 
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Update on boarding vs NPCs[/h3]
NPC reactions during boarding are bugged on the test server. This is a known issue and will be hotfixed tomorrow

notes.title: Test Server is Now Live with Gunpowder Major update
notes.content:
[b]Captains[/b],

We are happy to announce that the [b]Test Server[/b] is now available.

[h1]Goals for the Test Server[/h1]
 
[h3]To test the new complete overhaul for the game including:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage Model: Overhauled ammunition, HP, leaks, fires, thickness, boarding, and various other adjustments.
[*] Sailing Model: Streamlined speed profiles for all ships, rudder inertia, and other tuning improvements.
[*] Crafting: full overhaul of the crafting progression.
[*] Trading: Trade routes are back in full force providing stable trade routes and distance based pricing
[*] Player-Driven Economy and Hauling: Crafted goods required for combat and trading provide even better money making opportunities than trading. All higher level items have to be crafted by players.
[*] New Modules and Books: Complete overhaul of modules and books
[*] Dozens of other changes and improvements giving almost a new fresh experience.
[/list]
This weekend we are testing [b]NEW PLAYER AND BAHAMAS EXPERIENCE[/b], so every player will start from scratch with zero XP and money in Nassau. But don't worry - we will run a higher rank test early next week.

[h1]How to access the test server[/h1]
Instructions on how to unlock the test server and participate are posted on the official forum:
[url=https://forum.bermudaclub.net/topic/44292-naval-action-beta-test-server-%E2%80%93-how-to-participate/]How to Participate[/url]

REWARDS for participation on the Test Server will also be unveiled early next week.

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
Feedback can be provided here on Steam: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/311310/discussions/22/601897629488529956/]Steam Forums[/url]
And here on the official forum: [url=https://forum.bermudaclub.net/topic/44293-naval-action-beta-test-server-feedback-thread/]Official Forum[/url]

Most useful and thoughtful feedback providers will also receive a special reward once the live server patch goes live.

Also let us know if you have any questions in the comments.

notes.content:

[/b]

We are working to prepare a test server for this week. Test server will replace War Server which will shut down. 

The main reason for the delay this week is the attempt to find how we can save Clan Tags due to full user base wipe (we could not keep it). But we now can.

Clan Tags will be saved for the Caribbean server. 
Clan owners can reserve the clan tag here by posting their clan tag in the special topic on the forum. 
It will automatically tie the clan tag to the current clan owner and only he will be able to use it for some time after the big patch and server reset.

[b]Important information on the Captain Battle XP and wipe. 
[/b]Only Battle XP will remain after the reset. Everything else will be reset and wiped. 

[list]
[*] Current Captain battle XP points are tied to their Steam ID and server. 
[*] War server XP will be migrated to Caribbean server, and highest number will be used. If Captain had higher XP on War server - War server xp will be used. If he had higher XP on Caribbean - Caribbean level will be used. 
[*] Peace server XP will remain on Peace server. 
[/list]

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! The 2025 Holiday Event – Event Extended
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11602907/f1280a781c27be732c8c6f7cf157245703f9ffa2.jpg[/img]
Dear Naval Action Community,

We wish you all health, wealth, and happiness—both at sea and in real life!

[h3]The 2025 Holiday Event[/h3]

The Holiday Event will begin tomorrow, Wednesday, December 25th, after daily maintenance, and will continue until the end of the current season.

Special fleets of privateers will be sailing around the Windward Passage (the strait between Hispaniola and Cuba). These privateer ships will carry special chests containing rare guns and modules.

Loot, equip your ships with these guns and modules, and enjoy the battles!

[h3]Update: January 24[/h3]
Captains, the event has been extended by one week until January 31

[h3]Update: January 31[/h3]
Captains, the event has been extended by one week until Friday, February 7

notes.title: New patch - Insurance comes to Naval Action.
notes.content:
[h2]Сaptains. 
We will be deploying a series of 2 patches before the start of a new season. [/h2]

[list]
[*] First patch will deploy insurance and several other game play improvements (including mod nerfs).
[*] Second patch will deploy pre-final damage model that will feature improved balance between classes and return of proper working thickness and angling. 
[*] After testing combat and insurance - NPC port raiders will return to the Caribbean with good look and proper balance of battles. 
[/list]

[b]First patch will be deployed today 12th June.
[/b]
[h3]Important changes
[/h3][b]Key feature for testing: Insurance[/b]
[list]
[*] All ships can be insured. Insurance cost is 15% of the ship base value (which takes into account rarity and materials used to make a ship)
[*] If you lose the insured ship - Admiralty will return the same exact ship to you without guns and mods. 
[*] Insured ships cannot be captured. 
[*] We know that this feature is key and will change the flow of economy and combat drastically thus it is given out for testing first (before the updated final combat model with returning thickness).
[/list]
[b]Other Important changes
[/b][list]
[*] All events like patrol or seasonal leaderboards tiers have been reworked. Rewards are now provided for every tier and can be received immediately after the tier has been reached. 
[*] Fixed inconsistent water lines for all vessels. Penetrative leaks can now only be created if shooting under waterline (not at the waterline like before) 
[*] Reworked and fixed all bugs in mast colliders (fixed size issues, length issues and other various bugs)
[*] Boarding is has been made slightly easier  for 1-3rd rates. Splinter damage resistance has been lowered from 99% to 75%. Defensive and musket bonuses lowered allowing winning if you have proper fit out and have destroyed the enemy ship crew. It is still VERY HARD but now not impossible.
[*] Upgrades books and woods stats changed and generally lowered. Abnormal buffs have been lowered. Major key stats like reload, repair amounts, hp buffs, and others have been adjusted. 
[/list]

Here is a table showing changes to upgrades and books for the key stats: before and after
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11602907/c23a2aac722ad56d45c3f7fd155f86baefd7afb7.png[/img]

[b]Other changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Several paints added to DLC ships
[*] Battle information now has BR and ship class info (accessible by pressing TAB in battle)
[*] Changed time formats for quests
[*] Galeon added to the game and awaits steam approval
[*] Players can now rename ships (visible only for them) to help identify their vessels in the docs 
[/list]

[b]Minor tweaks that will be useful after the new season start
[/b][list]
[*] NPC distribution is now based on counties (not on regions) allowing better precise distribution of NPC ships across the map
[*] It is no longer allowed to build deep water ships in shallow ports
[*] It is no longer possible to upgrade shipyard in shallow water ports
[*] Towing ships functionality now checks for port depth
[/list]

notes.title: Forthcoming Large Update: Naval Action Reborn
notes.content:
Captains. 
Here is the information on the Forthcoming Large Update: named Naval Action Reborn!

The list is not complete but will provide you with general overview of improvements. 

Planned Changes 

[b]1) Focus on core activities[/b]
The game will only focus player attention in the following 4 areas. 
[list]
[*] RVR - Capturing and defending ports provides access to resources and NSM rewards through events
[*] Exploration and Trading - player traders will roam the world and look for rare resources not available anywhere else.
[*] PVE - will provide diverse meaningful loot and mostly relaxing combat experience
[*] PVP - will provide adrenaline and excitement for hunters (as usual)
[/list]

[b]All other activities that just cause time wasting and unnecessary clicks will be removed or completely cut. [/b]

[b]2. Ship crafting and general crafting changes
[/b]
[list]
[*] Shipyard will allow improvements of the ships that you own.
[*] Materials rebalanced and redundant materials cut from the game. 
[*] Unnecessary steps in crafting will also be cut.
[*] Ship permits will be abandoned
[*] Resource production in buildings will completely change. 
[/list]
[b]3. Spawn Changes
[/b]
All captains from across the world will arrive in the Caribbean through Nassau. Nassau will be made a free port. Bahamas will be made a Safe Area. Nearby deep water areas will also have safe zones. All other areas will be fully capturable (including former capitals). 

[b]4. Map Changes: 
[/b]
Map is too large and there are a lot of redundant ports and areas. Map will be made smaller and the number of ports will be reduced. This with changes in the starting area will allow much better distribution of NPC ships, and PvP in other areas. 

[b]5. National changes: 
[/b]
All flags will be incorporated into 4 alliances 
Britain - British Alliance - Britain, Russia
France - French Alliance - France, USA, Denmark, Sweden
Spain - Spanish Alliance - Spain, Prussia, Dutch
Pirates - Pirates
The distribution is not final - please provide your feedback in comments.

[b]6. Global chat will return
[/b]

[b]7. Class based upgrades.
[/b]
Universal module upgrades will be mostly abandoned. All mods and upgrades will be class based and will provide bonuses and alternatives to fit outs. All upgrades and books will be meaningful and useful. 

[b]8. ALL servers will have partial reset this time: (all servers will be wiped with minor exceptions) 
[/b]
[list]
[*] Due to significant final changes to economy, spawns, ship crafting and looting all economic elements of the game and map ownership will be reset on ALL SERVERS. This means there will be a full economy and map reset on all 3 servers = War and Peace and Caribbean
[*] XP will NOT be reset up to the maximum admiral level
[*] Investments of NSM - naval service medals - will not be wiped. All NSMs used for investments will be refunded to the money chest 
[/list]
Future resets - we are currently considering the fate of resets and their need. Please let us know your thoughts on wipes in comments.

[b]9. Combat mechanics: [/b]
[list]
[*] Based on all experiments in the past the final combat model will be deployed. It will provide more enjoyable and exciting combat between classes and will have predictable working thickness and smaller HP difference between classes);  a-la something that existed in 2017. This will greatly expand combat options especially against bigger ships (both in PVE and PVP). Overpowered boarding meta will also be fixed.
[*] Leaks - all problems with inconsistent leaks have been fixed and every ships checked and waterlines adjusted. Heel was balanced on all vessels and leaks will now be only created if you hit the heavily heeling ship. 
[*] Masts - all issues with masts have been fixed and every ship checked - for example some ships had shorter or longer colliders or thicker or thinner mast collision models. This all been cleared
[/list]
[b]10. Ship insurance[/b]

[list]
[*] Ship insurance will allow you to insure the vessel and return it intact if your ship sank in combat (without guns and mods)
[*] Ship insurance will block the enemy from ship capture (insured player ships can only be sank by players)
[/list]
[b]11. Events and races will be improved and reward tiers changes to provide better experience to all participants. [/b]

[b]12. Improved and rebalanced raiders[/b]

Raider fleets, their targes and their frequency will depend on the number of ports controlled by players. Raiders will pick targets more smartly and will no longer target only poor ports. The goal of raiders will be to provide loot and large battle opportunities on PVE server and also will act as a natural check on weird port battle timers.

[b]13. New ships will finally appear in the game. [/b]

[list]
[*] Duke of kent - event ship
[*] Galeon - Spanish shallow water DLC trader.
[/list]
[b]14. Multiple other changes
[/b]

notes.title: New Season Patch: Combat improvements, repairs and more
notes.content:
[h2][b]New seasonal Patch[/b][/h2]

[h2]Captains.[/h2]

We would like to announce a patch and a start of the new season. 

[h3][b]Caribbean Wipe/Reset information[/b][/h3]
Players combat experience, Captain chest, Player Name, ClanTag and Investments are kept and are NOT reset. Naval Service Medal Rewards for the finishing seasonal events Naval Service medals are moved to captain's chest.

All other assets and experience levels are reset (due to significant changes to gameplay and system mechanics). 

[h3][b]Major improvements to AI of NPC vessels[/b][/h3]
Combat AI have received full overhaul - here is the list of improvements
[list]
[*] AI will better avoid friendly obstacles
[*] AI accuracy bugs were fixed
[*] AI will better behave near land and will beach less
[*] AI will pick which side to choose for shooting much better and will know when to continue to turn and when to turn back as guns are close to reloading
[*] AI will be able to keep required distance moderately well
[*] AI will no longer stop shooting when avoiding obstacles
[*] AI will try to move out of current position at speed if something is blocking the shot
[*] AI will not stop when passing stationary or slow obstacles to the right or left
[*] AI will no longer get stuck in the wind trying to turn right and left due to bugs with logic
[*] AI will kite, or get close or stay at mid range depending on its role
[*] AI will use perks and books giving improvements to combat
[*] AI will no longer attempt to board the player (as it felt totally random before).
[*] Fleet composition. 1-2nd rates will no longer sail alone
[*] Fleet composition. 1-3rd rate ship variety has been increased 
[*] Fleet composition. Heavy fleets will no longer have light ships in them 
[*] Overall: AI is now more deadly and interesting.
[/list]

[h3][b]New player experience and quality of life improvements.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bot locations have been improved to provide smooth leveling experience with less gaps in NPC locations. Early levelling areas will have much more 5th rates. Amount of lineships around Hispaniola and Puerto Rico - increased. 
[*] Combat rank visualization in form of insignia added to open world and ship auction to give new players better understanding of the target level compared to his. Blue insignia - it is possible to kill a ship, Red Insignia - it might be hard without experience.
[*] Multiple other minor changes to help new and current players enjoy the game more.
[/list]

[h3][b]Repair changes[/b][/h3]

The goal of repairs is to a) help the player to recover from minor mistakes b) give the ability to not interrupt the fun and return to action after successful local engagement in large battles c) help to balance hit-points of ships both for large battles and small engagements d) ship that is repairing should be fighting as well as the ship that is not repairing.

[b]Changes to repairs. [/b] 

[list]
[*] Hull repairs will fix 50% of armor and 50% of structure
[*] Mast/Sail repairs will fix 75% of sails
[*] Player will only have one repair per hour (cooldown will be increased to 60 mins)
[*] Combat repair PERK  will reset the cooldown after you sink a ship granting additional repairs after local tactical victories in battles larger than 1v1. (In group battle to get kill counted your damage to target must be higher than damage of all other shooters)
[*] Amount of crew for repairing is significantly increase - reducing your ability to shoot all guns
[*] Time to repair is increased from 2 to 4 minutes at full crew on repairs (if your crew is lower the time will linearly increase)
[/list]

As a result. In 1v1 engagement the player can only have 1 repair; in 25v25 players of one side will have 1 repair per ship + up to maximum of 25 additional repairs per fleet based on the number of enemies they sink. This will promote action and naturally balance the speed of large battles. Ships repairing will not have full combat performance due to amount of crew required and time required to repair and will have to disengage and be protected.

[h3][b] RvR and port battle improvements .[/b][/h3]
To improve incentives to capture and control ports counties will allow clan owners to buy unique resources: currently permits, rare guns, rare woods. These resources will be available for doubloons at moderately low prices. 
[list]
[*] Resources will be available in all ports of the county which will reduce the chances to monopolize access by one clan (as it will be hard to keep all ports of the region).  
[*] For example Santisima permit currently drops from NPCs, in addition to that all ports in one county of the Caribbean will also deliver Santisima permits for controlling clan in exchange for certain currency. This will give an incentive to capture ports of that region to guarantee supply of permits.

Allied clans should help the port owner if they share these resources, if they dont clans should join another alliance.
Please provide the feedback on the supply and locations of those resources - also provide ideas on additional resources which we can add to clan barter.
[/list]

[b]Port battles [/b]- 
Players leaving the battle before it ends will count as a kill for the enemy and give points.

[h3][b]Privateering and Safe Zone changes.[/b][/h3]
Amount of ports with safe zones will be decreased but will still allow safe levelling up to heavy frigates. 

[h3][b]Crafting changes – special resources for Lineships [/b][/h3]
Ships of the line and heavy guns will now require up to 5 special resources for crafting, requiring logistic planning and some minimal amount hauling. 
Resource locations:
[list]
[*] Cartagena de Indias - Frame Timber
[*] Nuevitas - Cast Iron 
[*] Santo Domingo - Heavy Rope
[*] San Juan - Compass wood
[*] Cumaná - Mast Timber 
[/list]
There locations will create a lot of traffic and action in the Caribbean Sea. We are going to monitor their supply and traffic and add more locations (for example in the gulf) if needed. 
The resources are cheap and abundant, which will not cause tears when losing them to privateers. Clans that want to field large fleets of heavy crafted ships of the line will have to involve more players in either crafting and occasional hauling or in privateering to capture those resources by force.

We also plan to add some resources like gun drills for crafting heavy guns but this feature will appear later after we get feedback on the line ship resources.

[b]Tobacco changes[/b]
Tobacco is now 4 times heavier
Tobacco can only be sold in 3 locations
[list]
[*] Vera Cruz
[*] Gibraltar
[*] Kidd's Harbour
[/list]

[h3][b]Lineship rarity.[/b][/h3]
NPC Ships of the line - 3rd rates 2nd rates and 1st rates will be almost impossible to capture and all received extensive boarding bonuses. Avoid boarding NPC 3-1st rates at all costs. 

[h3][b]Boarding changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Boarding commands, costs and flow have been reworked and generally improved. Commands received better clear counters and boarding combat overall have been made more fluid and dynamic.
[*] Boarding immunity: Player who successfully defended against boarding will be immune from re-boarding for 1 min (cannot be boarded).
[*] NPC boarding: NPC no longer will attempt to board the player which will especially help lower level new players. 
[/list]

[h3][b]Combat changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tracking shot horizontal accuracy buffs removed!!! [/b]to remove the opportunity to shoot masts shot by shot. Tracking shot is still great for judging general distance (angle of shooting) by looking at splashes, but its almost useless to judge the deflection of the target. Long range shooting will require more skill as a result
[*] Critical damage to structure reduced from 6x to 3x. 
[*] Critical damage threshold reduced from 10% to 9%
[*] Rudder HP increased
[*] Overall ship structure is now 80% of its side.
[*] Broadside HP rebalanced for all vessels and generally became lower to provide appropriate time for solo battles.
[*] Penetration curves adjusted for all types of guns, accuracy
[*] Gun sector movement is now slower
[*]Medium guns now can penetrate targets at 1000m and are no longer basic trash guns. They have better DPM than long guns and should be used for medium and short range combat
[*]Long guns have lower DPM than medium guns but compensate it with accuracy and penetration at distance - they should be used for long range combat. 
[*]All guns including rare guns damage and reload numbers have been rebalanced to improve choices
[*]All cannons (except for carronades) lost accuracy to provide more realistic feeling to combat as we did not like laser guns as only option
[*]Carronade DPM and damage is rebalanced for carronades 32lb and below (32-12pd) to improve carronade/cannon damage balance on 5th rates and below. Vertical dispersion on carronades have been slightly improved (reduced from 17 to 11). But we think they can be improved even further. Please provide feedback on carronades after you tried them. 

[h3][b]Perk Changes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Perks have been reset for all players
[*] Perks rebalanced
[*] New perk lines added
[*] Cost of perks changed
[*] Unlocking 5 knowledge slots on the ship now grants 1 perk point. Unlocking knowledge slots on all ships significantly increases your perk selection options.
[/list]

Multiple other changes and improvements have also been applied. 

[/list]

Please discuss on Steam and Discord. We are looking for your gameplay feedback and suggestions on improvements.

*Spotlight image by Sato

notes.title: Forthcoming patch and Season information
notes.content:
[h2][b]Forthcoming patch information for the new season[/b][/h2]

Captains.

We would like to announce a patch and a start of the new season. Patch will be deployed somewhere next week. Most likely date is 22nd.

[h3][b]Wipe[/b][/h3]
All assets except for special chest (where you can transfer your items you want for the next season) will be reset on the patch date. Player Experience and investments will NOT be reset and will remain as is. All port ownership will be reset.

[h3][b]Major improvements to AI of NPC vessels[/b][/h3]
Combat AI have received full overhaul where we improved the behavior and fixed multiple found bugs
AI will now pick the role for combat (short range, medium range, long range kite), which will improve variety of combat and allow large fleets to behave more like human fleets (some will kite, some will brawl), AI will now pick targets better, maneuver and evade obstacles better. Multiple bugs with aiming, reloading, evasion fixed as well - full list of changes will be provided on the Patch date.

[h3][b]New player experience and quality of life improvements.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bot locations have been improved to provide smooth leveling experience with less gaps in NPC locations
[*] Combat rank visualization added to open world and ship auction to give new players better understanding of the target level compared to his.
[*] Multiple other minor changes to help new and current players enjoy the game more.
[/list]

[h3][b]Repair changes[/b][/h3]
We believe that this patch will bring the best implementation of repairs to date

The goal of repairs is to a) help the player to recover from minor mistakes b) give the ability to not interrupt the fun and return to action after successful local engagement in large battles c) help to balance hitpoints of ships both for large battles and small engagements d) ship that is repairing should be fighting as well as the ship that is not repairing.

Unfortunately current implementation was not solving these goals - and instead was increasing the length of many battles especially for lineships.

[b]Changes to repairs. [/b]
To solve the problems of current repairs and give natural balance to all battles (1v1 VS 25v25) the following changes will be done to repairs. 

[list]
[*] Player will only have one repair per hour (cooldown will be increased to 60 mins)
[*] Player is already able to gain additional repairs by sinking ships (gaining kills - by delivering most damage to enemy vessel). Combat repair perk price will be decreased as it is becoming a key perk for all battles. Combat repairs will reset the cooldown granting additional repairs after local tactical victories in battles larger than 1v1. 
[*] Amount of repairs to hull mast and structure will be adjusted to reflect goals listed above. 
[*] Amount of crew for repairing will be significantly increased forcing player to move them from other crew focuses
[*] Time to repair will be doubled. 
[/list]

As a result. In 1v1 engagement the player can only have 1 repair; in 25v25 players of one side will have 1 repair per ship + up to maximum of 25 additional repairs per fleet based on the number of enemies they sink. This will promote action and naturally balance the speed of large battles. Ships repairing will not have full combat performance due to amount of crew required and time required to repair and will have to disengage and be protected.

[h3][b]RvR and port battle improvements .[/b][/h3]
To improve incentives to capture and control ports counties will allow clan owners to buy unique resources like permits, rare guns, rare woods, and other things.
[list]
[*] Some resources will also be available on the NPC market in that port and/or only in clan barter (some will only be available for controlling clans).
[*] Resources will be available in all ports of the county which will reduce the chances to monopolize access by one clan (as it will be hard to keep all ports of the region).  
[*] For example Santisima permit currently drops from NPCs, in addition to that all ports in one county of the Caribbean will also deliver Santisima permits for controlling clan in exchange for certain currency. This will give an incentive to capture ports of that region to guarantee supply of permits.
[/list]

Port battles - Players leaving the battle before it ends will count as a kill for the enemy and give points.

[h3][b]Privateering and Safe Zone changes.[/b][/h3]
Amount of ports with safe zones will be decreased but will still allow safe levelling up to heavy frigates. 

[h3][b]Crafting changes – special resources for Lineships and Heavy Guns[/b][/h3]
Ships of the line and heavy guns will now require special resources for crafting, requiring logistic planning and some minimal amount hauling. Clans that want to field large fleets of heavy crafted lineships will have to involve more players in either crafting and occasional hauling or in privateering to capture those resources by force.

[h3][b]Lineship rarity.[/b][/h3]
Admiralty will no longer allow capture of the ships of the line from NPC ships reverting the capture rules to the older naval action version. Only 7th to 4th rates will be capturable from NPCs.

[h3][b]Boarding changes[/b][/h3]
Boarding commands, costs and flow have been reworked and generally improved. Commands received better clear counters and boarding combat overall have been made more fluid and dynamic.
Player who successfully defended against boarding will be immune from re-boarding for 1 min (cannot be boarded).

[h3][b]Combat changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Critical damage to structure will be reduced. Overall structure of ships will be modestly increased.
[*] Broadside HP will be reduced for heavy vessels.
[*] Penetration curves adjusted for all types of guns, accuracy
[/list]

Final full patchnotes will be posted on patch day. 

Please discuss on Steam and Discord. We will be visiting the steam forums and discord next week to answer questions and discuss the patch with you.

notes.title: Minor Patch: Insurance, Port battle BR limits and other minor changes.
notes.content:
[h3]Captains [/h3]

First insurance contracts were known from 1750 BC, it was done in form of the stone tablets and often had bugs stuck in the plates.  Removing them was a long and tedious process. But its never to late to fix a problem. 

[b]Insurance contracts major fix[/b]
There was a bug in insurance payouts that was overpaying for very cheap ships and underpaying a lot for expensive crafted vessels. From today the insurance will take into account the number of upgrade slots and quality and base prices of woods used in ship construction. As a result you will receive less for cheap fir or oak ships but will receive much more for expensive wood 5 slot vessels. 

[b]Port battle BR Fixes[/b]
As we promised some time ago port battle BR limits should reflect the number of ships provide for ship variety in some port and take into account the location of the port. We have changed BR limits for ports to reflect this. Its a first step and we will tweak it for perfection soon with your feedback. 

[b]Explosions[/b]
We do not like that many port battles can drastically change their flow due to one explosion - the system did not take into account much lower HP for masts as well. As a result we are lowering explosion damage for structure, masts, sails, and slightly for broadside planking. We kept the damage to crew the same - if you expect nearby explosions do not forget to brace. 

[b]NPCs in Patrols[/b]
NPCs in patrol areas were streamlined so all nations can find enemies in those locations. Lower level NPCs were also provded. 

[b]Wapen/Wasa[/b]
Wapen and Wasa ship crafting blueprints was fixed as they used incorrect number of wood logs before. 


We are very interested in feedback on explosions and their effect on battles, insurance payouts and port battle BR limits. 
Please provide feedback in discord or steam forums.

notes.title: Minor patch and His Majesty Royal Navy Surgeon opinion.
notes.content:
[h3]Captains[/h3]

It is a known fact that the main cause of injuries in the age of sail navies was not splinters or cannonballs; it was [b]hernia[/b]. The dangerous condition, caused by the hard work and constant pulling of heavy weights and rope, condition which was once described by His Majesty Royal Navy Surgeon - [u]Rear Admiral Humphrey De Vere[/u] - as scurvy of the sea, the menace of long naval patrols. But now lets talk about something completely different - patrols and XP. 

[h3]Patrol Tier Changes[/h3]
Patrols will now use their own tiers of damage; damage tiers will be reduced greatly for light ship patrols and so on. 

[h3]XP calculation for kills and assists. [/h3]
Currently the xp for kill is split between captains based on the % of their damage. This reduces motivations for group combat. 
[b]We have changed the system.[/b] To promote group activities the player who gets the kill will always receive full XP, assisters will get xp based on the % of damage they inflicted. This will encourage taking friends with you for NPC or player hunting. 

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
Top mast HP was increased, as it was too easily destroyed even at battle sails.

Patch will be deployed today - 25th of July -  at maintenance

notes.title: New season!
notes.content:
Captains!

New season starts today. We have big plans for the new season and will continue improving the game. 

[h2]Major changes[/h2]
[h3]New combat events added[/h3][list][*]3 timed competition combat events have been added to the game. Captains will be able to compete with other captains in the speed of destruction of several enemy ships for combat medals[/list]
[h3]Woods rebalancing[/h3][list][*]The wood has been rebalanced
[*]The old wood system was severely unbalanced, with many types of wood being completely useless and some heavily buffed[/list]
[h3]New approaches to balance:[/h3][list][*]Created several classes of wood, each with its own main characteristic and penalties to all other characteristics
[*]The higher the wood rarity, the greater the main bonus and the lower the penalty to other bonuses
[*]The higher the quality of the wood, the lower its drop chance or cost of obtaining in investments
[*]Base crafted woods have one bonus - rare woods can have several main bonuses[/list]
[h3]Slight structure increases[/h3][list][*]Structure have been increased for light and medium vessels to give a bit more durability. They still can be raked with ease - its just you need a bit more damage to deliver the critical skill shot[/list]
[h3]Masts damage and battle sails[/h3][list][*]Mast HP was lowered to allow easier demasting at full sails
[*]Battle sail mast damage reduction was increased to allow a lot more protection at battle sails and lower[/list]
[h3]Ship HP[/h3][list][*]Ship planking HP is slightly lowered for ships of the line. The overall balance of combat on higher level vessels is under review[/list]
[h3]PVP Zones trading[/h3][list][*]Rare woods are now only delivered to cities located in pvp zones
[*]Only PVP zones now provide best prices to sell trading resources
[*]NPC traders now try to avoid pvp zones when picking trading routes[/list]
[h2]Additional plans and known issues[/h2][list][*]BR limits for port battles are under review and will be improved within a short time after start of the season
[*]Fun and length of battles in lineships is under review
[*]Upgrade improvements are under way and will be delivered within 1-2 months after the start of the season
[*]Ship sail curves uniqueness will come back into the game
[*]Ship mass effect on speed and acceleration is under review 
[*]2 new races with different routes will be added to the game
[*]1 new DLC ship (also available through events) will be added to the game
[*]Perks major rebalance and unlock of additional perk points for ship knowledge slots is also coming
[*]Better visualization of enemy ships in the open world and ships in the auction so new players can see which ships they should or should not attack or can or cannot use[/list]
[h3]Other changes and improvements will also come during the season[/h3]

*Spotlight image by Captain Lord Dorian Beckett from the June 2021 screenshot competition.

notes.title: Hotfix: XP and grape shot improvements.
notes.content:
[h3]Captains

Hotfix will be deployed today. [/h3]

[b]XP Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Level XP: Amount of ship kills required to level up slightly decreased. XP Thresholds changed and mostly lowered for all levels below Vice Admiral. Your experience level will remain unchanged and you might have gained rank.  For example Kills to level up from 2nd rate to 1st rate were lowered from 45 ships (2nd rates) to 33 ship (2nd rate) kills to gain a level. 
[*] Ship knowledge (book slots) XP: Amount of XP required to unlock first 4 book slots is significantly lowered. Generally 1st slot will now require 1-2 kills, 2nd slot 3-4 kills maximum. Your ship knowledge experience have not changed and you might have gained unlocked slots. 
[*] XP For lower level ships: XP granted for sinking much lower rank ships has significantly increased. Sinking a cutter in Victory was giving 0.85xp and now gives 11xp (60% of ship BR). Sinking a Corvette was giving 25xp and will now grant 60xp. This change will make all targets valid and sinking them will not feel like waste of time. This is a major improvement for XP gains - all ships are much better targets xp wise. 
[/list]
Overall these changes will make progression less tedious. We will continue monitoring situation and make changes accordingly. 

[b]Grape shot improvements and changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Grape shot damage on lower level guns increased significantly. 
[*] Overall grape shot damage increased slightly for all guns
[*] Grape shot will no longer penetrate planking at any distance or any angle if planking HP is above 36%
[*] If planking is above 36% you will only achieve crew damage by grape if you hit crew directly: to the deck at angle or through windows or gun ports. 
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update: Safe zone, Ship race, New Combat model, and various other changes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Captains! Major update is being deployed today 15th of May

Changelog[/b][/h3]

[b][h3]Safe Zones [/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Most ports except for Hispaniola, Puerto Rico and Bahamas and deep blue sea have received protection zones. Safe areas are clearly indicated by green zones on the map (shortcut M).  You cannot attack enemy players in the Safe Zones. 
[*] This is a major change that will change Caribbean and PVP server and will give full protection to players who are just levelling up. NPC 3rd, Second rates and 1st rates will mostly sail in the PVP zones.
[/list]
[b][h3]Combat Rebalance[/h3][/b]
[h3]Damage changes output and DPS[/h3]
Gun damage: will be changed based on weight of the cannonball.
Example: Damage table of standard medium guns
[list]
[*] 4lb – 4 damage
[*] 6lb – 6 damage
[*] 9lb – 9 damage
[*] 12lb – 12 damage
[*] 18lb – 18 damage
[*] 24lb – 24 damage
[*] 32lb – 32 damage
[*] 36lb – 36 damage
[*] 42lb – 42 damage
[/list]
[list]
[*] Importance of heavy guns will drastically increase. Accurate shooting from lower gun decks becomes extremely important due to % in the total weight of the broadside. 
[*] Rare guns all received 10% buff to damage or splinter output. 
[*] Long guns have received significant bonus to accuracy.
[/list]
[b][h3]Ship hitpoints rebalance[/h3][/b]
[h3]Planking and Structure Changes.[/h3]
Planking have been gradually increased for ships heavier than light frigates. Ships of the line especially 1st rates will be able to tank multiple enemies with their broadside.

[h3]Damage to structure through bow and stern[/h3]
[list]
[*] Structure hitpoints have been reduced.  Making critical hits to structure through bow and stern devastating. 
[*] Ships will of course have some protection from skillshots by their bow and stern armor. The amount protection will depend on the ship and will increase with ship class. First rates can tank 2 full broadsides by stern and bow armor. Light ships will be able to hold only one. After that raking fire will crit. Captains can reduce stern and bow planking by shooting into certain areas when enemy is showing the broadsides. 
[/list]
[h3]Damage to structure through side planking [/h3]
[list]
[*] Once you lost planking to 30% it will no longer mitigate structure damage and structure will go down faster than before. This will still allow precision focus fire by a fleet when taking on the enemy ship of the line. 
[/list]
[h3]Repairs[/h3]
[list]
[*] To compensate drastically increased planking and reduced structure hull repairs have been changed. Hull repairs now repair 25% of planking and 50% of structure.
[/list]
[h3]Influence of new model on Tactics[/h3]
[list]
[*] The changes to planking and structure vs planking balance will increase the importance of tactics and the commander role, especially for heavy ships of the line (even commandeered by the new players).
[*] Lineships showing the side cannot be focused out easily by enemy line and can focus on fulfilling orders of the fleet commander, who will be maneuvering the fleet to cross the line and achieve rakes. Of course it will still be possible to sink enemy line ships through broadside, but the fleet trying to maneuver into rake shots will have a big advantage.
[*] Combat in heavier vessels will change - to resolve the battle captain will have to maneuver into rakes or wait for enemy mistakes (demasting him with chain at full sails, or raking with cannonballs when enemy shows the bow or a stern). 
[*] Gameplay in frigates - frigates will be able to tank some good damage with the broadside but still will be somewhat vulnerable to large group focus fire, but they will be able to resolve the combat very fast if they are good in positioning into rakes or exploiting enemy mistakes.
[*] Gameplay on the light vessels will not change - captain will only have to watch the broadside health more carefully and never tank with the stern or bow.
[/list]
[h3]Boarding Resistance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Due to increase of the role of skillshots in combat boarding resistance is implemented
[*] Boarding resistance will significantly reduce ALL incoming damage for ships on boarding.
[*] In addition - bracket fire [] will be removed completely, so the combat is resolved by boarding not outside influence.
[/list]
[h3]Perks Overhaul [/h3]

Perk systems have been completely overhauled. 
Perks are now split into 2 groups: perk trees and unsorted (that work as before).

[b]Perks chains/trees[/b]
[list]
[*] Seamanship
[*] Gunnery
[*] Boarding
[*] Survival
[*] Bravery
[*] Fleet
[/list]
Unsorted Perks (that work as previous system)
[list]
[*] Useful perks
[*] Economy perks
[/list]

All current perks have been reset and refunded. 

[b]Demasting changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Demasting is now easier if enemy is sailing at full sail
[*] Demasting is now harder if enemy is using battle sails
[/list]

[h3]Other important changes
[/h3]

[b]National ship auction
[/b]
[list]
[*] Ships listed in one nation will be visible and available for purchase in ALL cities of that nation. Giving crafters and sellers a much bigger market.
[*] Ships listed in neutral cities or freetowns will be visible in ALL freetowns and neutral cities.
[*] Price of the ship will depend on distance from the listing port.
[*] Ships sold to the admiralty might (if they are good) will be relisted on the auction by the government. 
[/list]

[b]Ship Race[/b]
[list]
[*] Solo competitive ship race will be introduced where captains will be able to test their ability to sail and maneuver against other captains. 
[*] First the race will be a weekly event. If the event is successful more events will be introduced. 
[*] Cost of ticket 250 Doubloons per attempt. All tickets sold will increase the prize pool.
[*] Top 10 winners will share the total prize pool 
[/list]

[b]Profitability of Ship crafting, Repair Crafting and Cannon making
[/b]
[list]
[*] Cost to make repairs and guns have been changed and generally improved. Crafters of guns and repairs will now have a lot more options to make money by crafting and distributing guns and repairs across the Caribbean. 
[*] We have returned back the system that existed before, where NPC only sail a limited selection of ships. All quests for ships that will no longer be used by NPCs will automatically complete. 
[*] Resources required to build ships have been generally reduced. 
[/list]

[b]NPC Ship Distribution
[/b]
[list]
[*] NPC Ships have been redistributed across the Caribbean, to support levelling in the open world. Captains can find appropriate targets right near capital and around national towns. Rank of enemy NPCs gradually increase the further you sail away from the capital closer to the center of the map. 3/2/1st rates are located around Hispaniola. 
[/list]

[b]Other changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Battle Ratings for all ships have been lowered
[*] Thresholds for rank have been changed and lowered (you might have gained rank)
[*] XP rewards for a for a Final exam have been removed. 
[*] Crew for all ships have been changed by class
[*] Santa Ana have been renamed to her proper name San Pedro
[*] NPC raids have been disabled for 2 weeks, until the combat model is settled and stabilized. 
[/list]

[b]Potential issues[/b]
[list]
[*] There could be issues with grape damage at lower gun calibers: we are investigating and will provide a hot fix soon. 
[*] Kill quests are temporarily disabled due to issues with low level missions some of which could not be completed due to changes in the combat model; for example fighting Trincomalee in a Cerberus or heavy rattlesnake in a Basic Brig
[/list]

Special topic will be open on Steam for patch feedback.
